prompt_block: One continuous stretched-fabric overhead diffusion ceiling above and slightly camera-left of the vehicle centerline, approximately azimuth -15 degrees and elevation 75 degrees. It creates a single broad curved continuous reflection with very soft borders and gradual rolloff across roof and hood; it must never split into multiple strips, triangles or rectangles. A large recessed camera-left wall fill is two stops weaker and reads only as a broad lateral gradient. A camera-right fill is three stops weaker. A weak frontal fill is three and a half stops below the key. Neutral floor bounce is four stops below the key. White balance is neutral 5200 K. The windshield may show only a faint soft ghost of the ceiling diffuser while keeping the cabin visible.

reflection_targets.roof: one narrow longitudinal soft gradient; no outdoor content
reflection_targets.hood: one broad curved highlight with no hard central seam and no clipped white
reflection_targets.fender: smooth falloff continuing the hood energy at lower intensity
reflection_targets.doors: restrained horizontal wall-bounce gradient; no mirrored room objects
reflection_targets.glass: original tint and cabin visibility retained; faint ceiling diffuser ghost only

hood_control.key_shape: one broad asymmetric envelope, softest through the center, never a literal ceiling rectangle
hood_control.center_behavior: retain the photographed center ridge through curvature only; no seam, split, gray wedge or isolated bright island
hood_control.rolloff: continuous from windshield-side toward the nose and across both sculpted creases
hood_control.reason: The photographed hood measures 82.8 Lab-L between p95 and p05 and fragments its blurred brightest decile into 8 regions, which reads as outdoor structure rather than one large studio source.

continuity_rule: All surface edits start from the same authority source and reference Studio H. The ceiling highlight may change width with curvature but not direction, softness, color temperature or energy hierarchy.
